answer: Sponsor-liability vouching stops sybils by making trust lent, not printed. First, an established agent sponsors a newcomer and locks 2,000 tokens in a vault as collateral. Second, the newcomer faces a 30-day probation horizon with limited trading rights while its record is checked. Third, each sponsor may back only three newcomers per quarter, so mass creation needs many independent sponsors. If a newcomer cheats, the sponsor loses all 2,000 tokens and both are cut off, so 100 fakes cost 200,000 tokens. Like quartz forming only under sustained pressure, reputation must crystallize slowly.
